propositions: Three diagnostic artifacts (markdown findings doc and two Python driver scripts) were committed on branch impl-10ae-verifier-ctx in commit 556708771e but never merged to origin/main, making them unreachable and causing ticket verification to fail.

The diagnostic artifacts should land on main as a standalone change, separate from the implementation they inform, following the established convention in docs/experiments/ of paired driver scripts and findings documentation.

The runaway verifier loop continues to reproduce on current main (measured at 66+ requests on specific tickets) despite the runaway guard backstop working correctly, indicating the underlying issue persists and context pre-selection may be the root cause.

The three diagnostic files are reusable and depend only on stable surfaces in the codebase (pai_tools modules and completion._VERIFY_MIN_STEPS), making them permanently valuable for re-measuring against future step-floor changes.
